liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Cambridge, Corpus Christi College, MS 383 (first copy)

others.text: Corpus 383 has the Treaty of Alfred and Guthrum twice. Liebermann prints both copies side by side, headed “B, p. 83” and “B 2, p. 6” (Gesetze I, p. 126); this site calls the first B1. So B1 is the copy on pp. 83–4, and B2 the copy on p. 6, which comes first in the book.
